description: Vault Exit Lawyer — Before moving treasury funds out of an ERC-4626 or ERC-7540 vault: reads the chain at one pinned block and returns how much can exit now, the haircut vs convertToAssets, partial-exit maximum, liquidity coverage, queue/cooldown timing, admin-power flags (upgrade, pause, multisig threshold, timelock), and a verdict EXIT_NOW_FULL / EXIT_PARTIAL / QUEUED / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN. With a holder it simulates

docsUrls.description: Public documentation pages whose redemption claims are checked against the contract.

exit.description: Exactly one of shares or assets, as base-unit integer strings. shares may be "max" (needs holder).

shares.description: Vault shares to redeem (base units), or "max" for the holder's whole balance.

holder.description: Address that holds the shares. Enables an exact eth_call redeem simulation and per-holder limits.

name: vault-exit-lawyer
